description: We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity for a COTA passionate about helping patients regain independence and improve their quality of life through therapeutic interventions.As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist, assisting with the implementation of individualized treatment plans. You will play a crucial role in providing direct patient care, documenting progress, and collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to achieve optimal patient outcomes. This full-time position offers a chance to make a significant impact within a supportive environment.
requirements: Current Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) license in Florida
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate for COTA is $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.
